home.title: A status page and basic availability monitoring for Cloudflare serverless deployments.
home.intro: Every number on this site comes from something that was actually measured. Status is derived at read time from recorded incidents and the most recent probe result, so a component nobody can measure is reported as unknown rather than as healthy.
home.notConfigured: No status page is configured for this deployment yet. Set DEFAULT_STATUS_SLUG to the slug you want this site to link to.

derived.title: Status derived, never stored
derived.body: A stored status field goes stale the moment a maintenance window ends, because no write happens when time passes. The snapshot carries evidence and the reader derives the verdict.

uptime.title: Uptime from real intervals
uptime.body: Downtime is computed by scanning recorded impact intervals with the worst overlapping severity per segment, so a fault that coincides with a maintenance window still counts.

honest.title: Unmeasured is not healthy
honest.body: A component with no probe, or whose probe stopped reporting, is shown as unknown. Reporting absence of evidence as uptime is the failure this is built to avoid.

home.diagnosticsHint: These controls exist to show that locale switching and theme switching work on this deployment.
home.feedHint: Every status page is available as Atom and as JSON, at the same path as the page itself.

summary.unknownExplanation: At least one component cannot be verified right now. Unverified is not the same as healthy, so it is reported as unknown rather than as operational.

components.heading: Components
components.empty: This status page has no components yet.
components.uncovered: No probe is configured for this component, so its status cannot be verified and is reported as unknown.
components.stale: That result is older than this component freshness budget, so the status is reported as unknown.
components.unclassified: The probe is failing but no incident has been classified against it, so the status is reported as unknown.

subscribe.description: We will email you a confirmation link. Nothing is delivered until you follow it.

errors.invalidEmail: That does not look like an email address.
errors.badSelection: One of the selected components is no longer available. Reload the page and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts for this address. Please try again later.
errors.unavailable: Subscriptions are not available right now. Please try again later.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again later.

meta.pageDescription: Current status, uptime history and incident log for {name}.
meta.stale: This page is showing the last snapshot that could be published. It may be out of date.
meta.unavailableBody: Nothing could be read for this page. Either it does not exist, or the storage behind it could not be reached.
meta.unreachableBody: The status service could not be reached at all, so nothing about this page is known right now.
meta.unavailableHint: This is not a statement that everything is fine. Try again shortly.
meta.footer: Status is derived at read time from recorded incidents and the most recent probe results. Uptime is computed from recorded impact intervals, and days without measurement are excluded from the percentage rather than counted as uptime.
